Sets the [audio latency](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/AudioContext/AudioContext) hint for the global `AudioContext` context that Remotion uses to play audio.<br />Possible values: `interactive`, `balanced`, `playback`

## CLI flag

```text
--audio-latency-hint <value>
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)
- [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)
- [`remotion still`](/docs/cli/still)
- [`remotion compositions`](/docs/cli/compositions)
- [`remotion bundle`](/docs/cli/bundle)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setAudioLatencyHint('interactive');
```
